bullets.id: Emas spot menutup pekan di $3.537,90 setelah sempat ke $3.502,93, terendah sejak September 2025. Dari sekitar $3.883 pada 13 November, emas turun sekitar 8,9% sepekan, penurunan mingguan terdalam dalam delapan bulan. Pasar libur akhir pekan, jadi harga ini menjadi titik awal pekan depan.
bullets.en: Spot gold ended the week at $3,537.90 after touching $3,502.93, the lowest since September 2025. From about $3,883 on Nov. 13, gold fell about 8.9% on the week, its steepest weekly decline in eight months. Markets are closed for the weekend, so this level is the starting point for next week.

bullets.id: CME FedWatch mencatat peluang sekitar 99% kenaikan 25 bps pada rapat Fed 8–9 Desember. Aksi jual saham berbasis AI ikut memaksa likuidasi emas, menurut High Ridge Futures, dan S&P 500 turun 3,70% Jumat. Sisi positifnya, yield 10 tahun turun ke sekitar 4,94%, ekspektasi inflasi Michigan turun ke 3,7% dari 4,7%, dan permintaan fisik di India dan China meningkat.
bullets.en: CME FedWatch shows about a 99% chance of a 25 bp hike at the Fed’s Dec. 8–9 meeting. The AI-driven equity sell-off also forced gold liquidations, according to High Ridge Futures, and the S&P 500 fell 3.70% on Friday. On the plus side, the 10-year yield fell to about 4.94%, Michigan one-year inflation expectations dropped to 3.7% from 4.7%, and physical buying in India and China picked up.

bullets.id: Kitco mencatat resistance di $3.597 lalu $3.699, dengan support di $3.475 lalu zona $3.400–$3.420 jika $3.500 tertembus. Agenda pekan ini: PMI awal November dan indeks Chicago Fed pada Senin 23 November; bursa AS libur Kamis 26 November untuk Thanksgiving dan tutup lebih awal Jumat.
bullets.en: Kitco lists resistance at $3,597 then $3,699, with support at $3,475 and then the $3,400–$3,420 zone if $3,500 breaks. This week’s agenda: preliminary November PMIs and the Chicago Fed index on Monday, Nov. 23; US markets are closed Thursday, Nov. 26, for Thanksgiving and close early on Friday.

bullets.id: Antam 1 gram stagnan di Rp2.495.000 dengan buyback Rp2.095.000 (spread Rp400.000, sekitar 16%). Sepekan, harga jual hanya turun Rp27.000 (1,07%), tetapi buyback anjlok Rp203.000 (8,83%), seiring emas dunia. Galeri24 turun Rp22.000 ke Rp2.334.000 (buyback Rp2.195.000) dan UBS turun Rp21.000 ke Rp2.357.000 (buyback Rp2.171.000).
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram bar held at Rp2,495,000 with buyback at Rp2,095,000 (spread Rp400,000, about 16%). Over the week the selling price fell only Rp27,000 (1.07%), but buyback plunged Rp203,000 (8.83%), in line with world gold. Galeri24 fell Rp22,000 to Rp2,334,000 (buyback Rp2,195,000) and UBS fell Rp21,000 to Rp2,357,000 (buyback Rp2,171,000).
